# WASP-121 b: WASP-17 (F6V) proxy spectrum at the planet's orbit
# columns: wavelength [A]  flux at the planet [erg cm^-2 s^-1 A^-1]
# reference: Huang et al. (2023), ApJ 951, 123 (2023ApJ...951..123H),
#            section 2.2: SED rescaled by the integrated XUV flux
#            F_XUV = 1.6e6 erg cm^-2 s^-1 and by the stellar radius,
#            LLmodels longward of 1700 A, Lya flux 1.0e5 erg cm^-2 s^-1.
# proxy:     MUSCLES v24 const-res broadband SED of WASP-17 (F6V), flux at
#            Earth (France et al. 2016, 2016ApJ...820...89F; Behr et al.,
#            MUSCLES Extension). Longward of 1700 A it is HST/STIS G230L and
#            G430L plus a PHOENIX photosphere; its EUV is a Linsky scaling
#            model and its Lya a young-star model, so its XUV shape is not
#            measured either.
# scaling 1: lambda < 1700 A x 7.450159e+20 so that F(10-912 A) = 1.6000e+06
#            (Huang section 2.2; the 1.6e6 is Salz et al. 2019, A&A 623, A57, whose XUV is
#            lambda < 912 A: log10 F_XUV = 6.2 from log10 L_X = 30.0, King et al. 2018 relations)
#            erg cm^-2 s^-1 at the planet.
# scaling 2: Lya window 1206.0-1226.0 A, the line above its local continuum
#            x 4.835670e-02 so that the line flux is 1.000e+05 erg cm^-2 s^-1.
# scaling 3: lambda >= 1700 A x 1.206591e+19 so that the bolometric flux at the
#            planet is sigma T_eff^4 (R_star/a)^2 = 7.002775e+09 erg cm^-2 s^-1
#            with T_eff = 6459 K, R_star = 1.4572 R_sun, a = 0.02544 au
#            (Huang Table 1); BOLOFLUX = 5.803769e-10 erg cm^-2 s^-1 from the
#            FITS primary header. No distance or radius of WASP-17 enters.
# join:      one step at 1700.0 A, f(above)/f(below) = 0.0164, measured.
# negatives: 4 source rows below zero set to 0
# units:     the MUSCLES product is already erg cm^-2 s^-1 A^-1.
# coverage:  10.0000 to 5000.0000 A, 4991 rows, strictly increasing.
# caveat:    see build_wasp121b_solar_huang.py: with F_XUV = 1.6e6 the
#            700-800, 800-912 and 912-1170 A band fluxes exceed the values
#            Huang et al. quote for their own spectrum. Rebuild with
#            --fxuv 2.69e5, their Lyman continuum flux, for the other reading.
# built by inputdata/sed/build/build_wasp121b_wasp17.py
